author: PlayStation
description:
Axis of the Worlds have fallen. The waters have run dry. The world of Daba is dying of thirst.

You are a clayman that should never have awakened, walking across the ruined snowfields and desolate deserts. The shattered souls of fallen gods rain down from the sky, and a plague creeps in the shadows.

Beneath the ancient mask, twin blades rest in your grip. Cross the parched earth, cut the lies.
The missions forced upon you. The ambitions that burn. And every hand that tries to pull your strings.

Seize the water, reforge the divine soul. Even if shattered, rise from the ruins and push forward.

The one bound to your fate awaits you at the end of the road.

#ps5 #ps5games #stateofplay
title: Daba: Land of Water Scar - Official Trailer | PS5 Games

author: PlayStation
description:
New York City in the 1920s—a dazzling metropolis filled with the sound of jazz and the glow of soaring skyscrapers.
 
 While the city reveled in its glamour, an unseen conflict simmered among those who practiced magick in secret.
 
 Arriving in New York to pursue a career as a jazz singer, the young magus Ellie soon finds herself caught in an unexpected incident. The encounter leads her to Ilya, leader of the Seekers, an elite organization of magi.
 
 Though the free-spirited Ellie and the serious-minded Ilya frequently clash, they gradually forge a strong bond as they investigate the schemes of a mysterious mafia organization.
 Their investigation draws them ever deeper into the city's secrets, revealing a fateful battle that threatens the very balance of the world.
 
 An epic tale unfolds where beasts, magick, friendship, and destiny intertwine.

Where the Seeds Fall is the debut title from CygamesEdge, a new label from Cygames, coming November 5, 2026 to PlayStation 5.
  
The earth has been afflicted with Blight, forcing humanity to build new homes upon the branches of the World Tree.
  
It is a place fraught with peril, and in their fear, humanity has branded ""Fell Children"" as omens of disaster. After encountering a Fell Child, however, one soldier goes against orders and determines to escort them to the surface world.
  
Descend the World Tree by navigating ruins, reading the wind, and taking leaps of faith in this thrilling action-adventure game.
